parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json.body||$input.first().json; const d=input.acquisition_decision||{}; const identityReady=Boolean(input.candidate_key||input.normalized_identity_key||input.parcel_id||input.propertyId); const seller=input.seller||input.owner||{}; const proposed=input.proposed_offer_amount??d.mao; const amount=Number(proposed); const amountReady=Number.isFinite(amount)&&amount>0; const missing=[]; if(!identityReady) missing.push("property_identity"); if(!amountReady) missing.push("proposed_offer_amount_or_mao"); if(!seller.name&&!input.seller_name&&!input.owner_name) missing.push("seller_name"); const decision=String(d.decision||"needs_data").toLowerCase(); const ready=decision==="offer_ready"&&missing.length===0; const offerId=input.offer_id||("offer-"+(input.dealId||input.deal_id||input.candidate_key||Date.now())); const strategy=String(input.offer_strategy||"standard_wholesale").trim(); return [{json:{...input,offer:{offer_id:offerId,status:ready?"draft_ready":"needs_review",draft_only:true,send_authorized:false,offer_strategy:strategy,proposed_offer_amount:amountReady?amount:null,maximum_allowable_offer:d.mao??null,expiration_date:input.expiration_date||null,seller:{name:seller.name||input.seller_name||input.owner_name||null,phone:seller.phone||input.seller_phone||null,email:seller.email||input.seller_email||null},missing_fields:missing,review_required:true,identity_ready:identityReady,acquisition_decision:decision},crm_stage:ready?"offer_draft_ready":"offer_review_needed"}}];
